text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Can you hear it?
Those cheers praising me."
(WAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If you hear it, it's an auditory hallucination.
Because that's—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Because it's a hymn destined to resound in the future.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, let the curtain rise. The curtain on a magnificent opera.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yes, this is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Blessed with striking beauty and unrivaled power—
the tale of the birth of the "End of Century Overlord"!

T.M. Opera O's entry into the Twinkle Series
has finally been decided.

I have to let her know right away.
Normally, an Umamusume would be at the training track
at this hour, but...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, how magnificent! Myself, my reflection
in the mirror, and even the polished floor I stand upon!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It is so exquisitely precious that I worry the mirror might shatter.
Actually, no—let it shatter!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...Why won't it break?
choice_data_list: T.M. Opera O, do you have a moment?
T.M. Opera O, got a sec?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hm, well if it isn't
my Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What brings you here at this hour?
Did you rush over just to gaze upon my beautiful face?
choice_data_list: Our entry in the Twinkle Series has been decided!
We're set to race in the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: O-Oh, ohhhh?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What did you say just now?
I couldn't hear clearly, but could it be...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Did you say... that your participation in the Twinkle Series has been decided?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see, I see.
The time has finally come, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Looking back, Umamusume fans have suffered a tremendous loss until now. That is because...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
For they were unable to witness the race of the most beautiful,
most talented, and most noble me.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To live without knowing of my existence is a total waste of life.
It is no different from being imprisoned at the bottom of an abyss...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Truly an era devoid of light!
However, those dreary days are finally over!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"I must make the presence of this Overlord, T.M. Opera O, known
to the people and bring them happiness as soon as possible."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now that our entry is set, there's no time to dawdle.
Come, Trainer, let us conquer our training!
And so, though we came to the track—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: *Ahem*, first let's practice the victory speech.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"To do that…… first, a light jog
across the azure turf!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
*Haa, fuu*, I have no time to be out of breath.
The crowd is waiting for my words!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hello, hello everyone! Did you get a look
at my beautiful run?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I am none other than T.M. Opera O!
The existence known as the most powerful and beautiful "Overlord."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: And so—this is the Umamusume who will rule the world as the End-of-Century Overlord!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Wait, this isn't the end of the century?
Hmm—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Fret not. Before my beauty,
even the century itself blushes and gently fades
into twilight before one knows it."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!
—This is T.M. Opera O-style training.
Woven into my conduct as the "Supreme King" are moments that enhance my running ability... or perhaps not...

Her performances are quite over the top, but on the other hand,
she truly has the potential to match calling herself a king.
That strong self-assertiveness and her sheer ability are two sides of the same coin.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, the prelude is over.
Now we are fully prepared.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely become the 'Overlord of the Century's End,'
giving dreams to all through overwhelming victory.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"From an incarnation of beauty known to none,
into an absolute sun that illuminates the people and the world!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-kun. Shall we take our first steps
upon our victory road?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, guide me.
To the pinnacle of the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!

Despite asking for a guide,
TM Opera O proudly took the lead herself.
And then—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Come, everyone, celebrate!
My grand departure!

Standing atop the rooftop, she roared with laughter. Down on the
school grounds, the Umamusume could only gaze up in utter dumbfoundment.
